title: Accessibility, localization and low-vision inclusive banking UX
workflow: Document task flows and financial confirmation screens on desktop/mobile
Specify responsive layout with no clipping, overlap, excessive glow or cramped controls
Support readable text scale, color contrast, keyboard and screen-reader semantics
Localize currency, dates, banking terms and error explanations without changing amounts
Design explicit pending/failed/unknown success states and accessible recovery
Test representative assistive-tech users and record actual results
invariants: Color is never sole indicator of account restriction or transaction status
A visual success animation cannot replace settled server evidence
Dynamic type resizing cannot hide amount, fee, recipient or confirmation details
Do not translate regulated product terminology without legal/content review
Focus order and error messages remain usable without mouse
Responsive mobile experience should behave like a coherent app, not a clipped desktop page
Customer authorization does not depend on inaccessible controls
acceptance_tests: 200% text zoom without overlapping payment controls
Screen reader announces amount, currency and recipient
High contrast shows status without color-only cues
Localization retains same exact monetary value
independent_gate: Approved institution design system, accessibility criteria and real desktop/mobile/assistive-tech test runs.
